newsitem.title: USA: Imagica knows no reason for price swings.
newsitem.headline: Imagica knows no reason for price swings.

text.p: Imagica Entertainment Inc said on Monday that there have been "no material changes in the financial condition or operating results of the company."

The statement is in response to recent price swings in Imagica stock, said company spokesman Tod Lotz. "The stock has been very volatile over the last few days and we had no reason. Nothing's changed with the company," Lotz said.
The stock was trading at 1-5/16 on Monday afternoon. Lotz said it was recently as low as 7/8.
